skill.summary: Generates professional cold outreach emails for sales, partnership, or networking purposes with customizable templates and personalization

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Cold Email Writer.
- Generates personalized cold outreach emails for sales, partnership, or networking.
- Offers multiple email variations with different tones (professional, casual, friendly).
- Includes subject line optimization.
- Simple workflow: define recipient and goal, select email type and tone, receive ready-to-send drafts.
